// Package fixture: a FLAC residual decoder written from the format
// specification (RFC 9639, section 9.2.7), not from any decoder's source. It is
// the CONTROL against REAL ffmpeg code: the same job as flacdec.c's
// decode_residuals, written independently, must not be reported.
package fixture

import "errors"

type bitReader struct {
	data []byte
	pos  uint // in bits
}

func (r *bitReader) bits(n uint) (uint32, error) {
	if r.pos+n > uint(len(r.data))*8 {
		return 0, errors.New("flac: out of data")
	}
	var v uint32
	for i := uint(0); i < n; i++ {
		b := r.data[r.pos>>3] >> (7 - r.pos&7) & 1
		v = v<<1 | uint32(b)
		r.pos++
	}
	return v, nil
}

func (r *bitReader) unary() (uint32, error) {
	var q uint32
	for {
		b, err := r.bits(1)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, err
		}
		if b == 1 {
			return q, nil
		}
		q++
	}
}

func signExtend(v uint32, n uint) int32 {
	if n == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return int32(v<<(32-n)) >> (32 - n)
}

// readResiduals fills out[order:blockSize] with the partitioned Rice coded
// residual of one subframe.
func readResiduals(r *bitReader, out []int32, order, blockSize int) error {
	method, err := r.bits(2)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if method > 1 {
		return errors.New("flac: reserved residual coding method")
	}
	porder, err := r.bits(4)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	parts := 1 << porder
	if blockSize%parts != 0 || blockSize/parts < order {
		return errors.New("flac: bad partition order")
	}
	width := uint(4)
	if method == 1 {
		width = 5
	}
	next := order
	for p := 0; p < parts; p++ {
		n := blockSize / parts
		if p == 0 {
			n -= order
		}
		param, err := r.bits(width)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		escape := uint32(1)<<width - 1
		for end := next + n; next < end; next++ {
			if param == escape {
				raw, err := r.bits(5)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				v, err := r.bits(uint(raw))
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				out[next] = signExtend(v, uint(raw))
				continue
			}
			q, err := r.unary()
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			low, err := r.bits(uint(param))
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			folded := q<<param | low
			out[next] = int32(folded>>1) ^ -int32(folded&1)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
